description: Bounded tools for a caller-authorized assistant. These are Workspace HTTP ports, not auto-registered Langflow nodes or privileged native writers.
authentication: Forward the actual caller Bearer token to Workspace; never substitute an administrator or another human identity.

tools.name: workspace_decisions
tools.purpose: List scoped, assigned dossiers; retain has_more and warnings.

tools.name: workspace_my_tasks
tools.purpose: Read mine-only Flowable tasks; a partial or failed read never means all tasks are complete.

tools.name: workspace_explain_decision

input.revision_id: current revision UUID from the dossier

tools.purpose: Read current-authorized evidence and return contracts/portal/schemas/run-result.schema.json. All numbers come from stored canonical calculations; the model does not compute KPIs.

rules: Ask for a dossier or supported intent when the request is ambiguous. Respect revision conflicts and never silently switch revisions.
Do not synthesize SQL, JavaScript, chart expressions, data values or source references.
Do not expose submit, task completion, approve, event sync, handoff verification or native business write ports as autonomous assistant tools.
Reads may refresh the local workflow status projection; they never approve a process, complete a human task or write business-owner records.
RunResult completed means the answer is built. Only the verified dossier status proves physical carrier handoff; it never means delivery to the customer.
No existing Langflow node or connection is changed by this manifest.
